is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 2, Methods).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains with known kdr (L1014F) genotypes (page 2, Methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The study uses established laboratory strains (Kisumu and KisKdr) and their crosses. It does not report genotype data for field-collected populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory reference strains (Kisumu and KisKdr) maintained in an insectary, not field-collected populations (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical laboratory study.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains, not field-collected samples from specific locations.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study uses laboratory strains, not field-collected samples with a collection date.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a laboratory study using established reference strains.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data is provided in the main text and figures.

assessment.summary: This study investigates the fitness costs (fecundity, fertility, larval survivorship, blood-feeding success, and longevity) of the kdr (L1014F) mutation in laboratory strains of Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Kisumu and KisKdr). It is not eligible because it does not involve field-collected mosquito populations.
exclusion_reasons: The study uses laboratory reference strains, not field-collected populations.
No field-collected genotype data is reported.
